title: chat-wss-00 L232: senderId 'MUST NOT be the accountId' is stale
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md L232 says TypingEvent senderId is 'The ChatContact.id of the typing user. MUST NOT be the accountId.' This contradicts jmap-chat-compliance-tests.md test 2.2 (L113-119, a MUST: the owner's senderId is the accountId) and the draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 identity model (owner senderId = accountId). crate-jmap follows the compliance test (commit e8ad58d2 'fix(chat)!: owner senderId is the accountId'; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/ephemeral.rs L58-59). The draft text is stale: rewrite L232 to match the chat-00 identity model (owner = accountId, others = ChatContact.id). No code change. Source: crate-jmap spec gap audit 2026-10-19.
